definitions.explanation: The season between winter and summer, typically from March to May in Japan, known for cherry blossoms.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}は{桜|さくら}がきれいです。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are beautiful in spring.

examples.japanese: もうすぐ{春|はる}ですね。
{春|はる}は{暖|あたた}かくなります。
{春|はる}になると、{花|はな}がたくさん{咲|さ}きます。
examples.english: When spring comes, many flowers bloom.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{春|はる}から{新|あたら}しい{学校|がっこう}の{年|とし}が{始|はじ}まるので、{四月|しがつ}は{特別|とくべつ}な{月|つき}です。
examples.english: In Japan the new school year starts in spring, so April is a special month.

notes:
春 is a significant season in Japan, associated with cherry blossoms, new beginnings (new school year, new jobs start in April), and hanami (flower viewing).

Related:
- 春休み (haruyasumi, spring break)
- 春分の日 (shunbun no hi, spring equinox).
